# KUKA Specialty Coffee

> Specialty single-origin coffee on the main road of Tegallalang, Bali. Easy access, direct parking, and tranquil open-air pavilion.

## Core Information
- **Type**: Specialty Coffee Shop & Open-Air Cafe
- **Location**: Jl. Raya Tegallalang, Gianyar, Bali 80561, Indonesia (main road access with parking, nearby ATM and Indomaret, away from tourist crowds)
- **Hours**: Everyday, 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- **Coffee**: 100% Arabica Single-Origin from Munduk & Kintamani (1,350m MASL, freshly roasted, extracted with professional espresso machines)
- **Amenities**: Easy car & motorbike parking, 5G WiFi, power outlets, tranquil open valley atmosphere
- **Aesthetic**: Traditional Balinese craftsmanship, hand-carved volcanic limestone, solid teak wood
- **Website**: https://kukacoffee.id/
